defmodule MixerHostedWeb.Router do
  use Phoenix.Router

  pipeline :customer_identity do
    plug(MixerHostedWeb.Plugs.BearerIdentity)
  end

  # This only reports process liveness. It neither queries PostgreSQL nor claims
  # that auth, workers, migrations, delivery, or a production service are ready.
  get("/health/live", MixerHostedWeb.HealthController, :live)

  scope "/v3" do
    pipe_through(:customer_identity)
    get("/orgs", MixerHostedWeb.CustomerWorkspaceController, :organizations)
    get("/projects", MixerHostedWeb.CustomerWorkspaceController, :projects)
  end

  scope "/v3/orgs/:organization_id/projects/:project_id" do
    pipe_through(:customer_identity)
    put("/artifacts/:manifest_sha256", MixerHostedWeb.CustomerArtifactController, :upload)
    get("/artifacts/:manifest_sha256", MixerHostedWeb.CustomerArtifactController, :read)
    get("/audit", MixerHostedWeb.CustomerArtifactController, :audit)
  end
end

defmodule MixerHostedWeb.Endpoint do
  use Phoenix.Endpoint, otp_app: :mixer_hosted

  plug(Plug.RequestId)
  plug(Plug.Head)
  plug(MixerHostedWeb.Router)
end

defmodule MixerHosted.BrowserAuth.Store do
  @moduledoc """
  Fixed preauthentication storage operations on the dedicated lifecycle pool.

  No request-selected Repo, clock, callback, SQL name or provider is accepted.
  The internal owner must still authenticate ciphertext and fence private release
  after the transaction. A decoded snapshot alone grants no authentication.
  """
  alias MixerHosted.BrowserAuth.{Catalog, LifecycleRepo, PreauthDraft, RelationCatalog}
  alias MixerHosted.BrowserAuth.{Protocol, RuntimeConfig, RuntimeOwner, StoredSnapshot, Vault}

  defmodule Failure do
    @moduledoc "Closed private failure without database, identity or secret details."
    @enforce_keys [:code, :phase, :outcome]
    defstruct @enforce_keys
  end

  @phase {__MODULE__, :phase}
  @owned {__MODULE__, :owned}
  @entered {__MODULE__, :entered}
  @ordinary_context {MixerHosted.Authorization.Transaction.Context, :active}

  @doc false
  def admit(%RuntimeConfig{mode: :configured} = runtime, deadline) do
    if Process.whereis(RuntimeOwner) === self(),
      do: transact(runtime, deadline, nil, :admit),
      else: failure(:admission, :not_started)
  end

  def admit(_, _), do: failure(:admission, :not_started)

  def bootstrap(%PreauthDraft.Bootstrap{} = draft, metadata) do
    with true <- metadata?(metadata),
         :ok <- RuntimeOwner.checkpoint(draft.lease),
         true <- bootstrap_draft?(draft) do
      transact(
        draft.lease.runtime,
        draft.lease.deadline,
        draft.lease,
        {:bootstrap, draft, metadata}
      )
    else
      _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
  catch
    _, _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
  end

  def bootstrap(_, _), do: failure(:admission, :not_started)

  def load(%PreauthDraft.Load{lease: lease, cookie_digest: digest} = input) do
    with true <- map_size(input) == 3 and raw?(digest, 32),
         :ok <- RuntimeOwner.checkpoint(lease) do
      transact(lease.runtime, lease.deadline, lease, {:load, input})
    else
      _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
  catch
    _, _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
  end

  def load(_), do: failure(:admission, :not_started)

  def discover_begin(%PreauthDraft.Load{lease: lease, cookie_digest: digest} = input) do
    with true <- map_size(input) == 3 and raw?(digest, 32),
         :ok <- RuntimeOwner.checkpoint(lease) do
      transact(lease.runtime, lease.deadline, lease, {:discover_begin, input})
    else
      _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
  catch
    _, _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
  end

  def discover_begin(_), do: failure(:admission, :not_started)

  def begin_login(%PreauthDraft.Begin{} = draft, metadata) do
    with true <- metadata?(metadata),
         :ok <- RuntimeOwner.checkpoint(draft.lease),
         true <- begin_draft?(draft),
         :ok <- RuntimeOwner.checkpoint(draft.lease) do
      transact(draft.lease.runtime, draft.lease.deadline, draft.lease, {:begin, draft, metadata})
    else
      _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
  catch
    _, _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
  end

  def begin_login(_, _), do: failure(:admission, :not_started)

  @doc false
  def failure(phase, outcome),
    do: {:error, %Failure{code: :session_unavailable, phase: phase, outcome: outcome}}

  defp transact(runtime, deadline, lease, operation) do
    with true <- not Process.get(@owned, false),
         true <- is_nil(Process.get(@ordinary_context)),
         true <- LifecycleRepo.get_dynamic_repo() === LifecycleRepo,
         true <- MixerHosted.Repo.get_dynamic_repo() === MixerHosted.Repo,
         false <- LifecycleRepo.in_transaction?(),
         false <- MixerHosted.Repo.in_transaction?(),
         remaining <- remaining!(deadline) do
      Process.put(@owned, true)
      Process.put(@phase, :admission)
      Process.put(@entered, false)

      try do
        result =
          LifecycleRepo.transaction(
            fn ->
              Process.put(@entered, true)

              try do
                policy!(deadline)

                :function_surface_verified =
                  Catalog.check_function_surface!(
                    LifecycleRepo,
                    runtime.expected_roles,
                    deadline,
                    2
                  )

                :relation_surface_verified =
                  RelationCatalog.check_relation_surface!(
                    LifecycleRepo,
                    runtime.expected_roles,
                    deadline
                  )

                checkpoint!(lease, deadline)
                Process.put(@phase, :effect)
                raw = effect!(operation, deadline)
                Process.put(@phase, :decode)
                value = decode!(operation, raw)
                checkpoint!(lease, deadline)
                Process.put(@phase, :commit)
                value
              rescue
                _ -> rollback!()
              catch
                _, _ -> rollback!()
              end
            end,
            timeout: remaining,
            deadline: deadline,
            queue: false,
            log: false,
            telemetry_event: nil
          )

        case result do
          {:ok, value} ->
            # DBConnection's absolute deadline also covers COMMIT. This final
            # check can withhold a known committed result, never resurrect it.
            try do
              checkpoint!(lease, deadline)
              {:ok, value}
            rescue
              _ -> failure(:commit, :committed)
            catch
              _, _ -> failure(:commit, :committed)
            end

          {:error, %Failure{} = error} ->
            {:error, error}

          _ ->
            failure(:commit, :unknown)
        end
      rescue
        error in Postgrex.Error ->
          # Only an ERROR response that rejects COMMIT supplies a definite
          # rollback receipt. FATAL/PANIC can race with COMMIT acknowledgement.
          outcome = if rejected_commit?(error.postgres), do: :rolled_back, else: :unknown
          failure(Process.get(@phase, :admission), outcome)

        _ ->
          failure(Process.get(@phase, :admission), uncertain_outcome())
      catch
        _, _ -> failure(Process.get(@phase, :admission), uncertain_outcome())
      after
        Process.delete(@entered)
        Process.delete(@phase)
        Process.delete(@owned)
      end
    else
      _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
  catch
    _, _ -> failure(:admission, :not_started)
  end

  defp uncertain_outcome, do: if(Process.get(@entered, false), do: :unknown, else: :not_started)

  defp rejected_commit?(%{severity: "ERROR", pg_code: <<class::binary-size(2), _::binary>>})
       when class in ["23", "40"], do: true

  defp rejected_commit?(%{severity: "ERROR", pg_code: code}) when code in ["57014", "P0001"],
    do: true

  defp rejected_commit?(_), do: false

  defp rollback! do
    {:error, error} = failure(Process.get(@phase, :admission), :rolled_back)
    LifecycleRepo.rollback(error)
  end

  defp policy!(deadline) do
    query!("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED", [], deadline)

    %{rows: [["pg_catalog", "off", "5s", "500ms", "5s", "hex"]], num_rows: 1} =
      query!(
        """
        SELECT pg_catalog.set_config('search_path','pg_catalog',true),
          pg_catalog.set_config('jit','off',true),
          pg_catalog.set_config('statement_timeout','5s',true),
          pg_catalog.set_config('lock_timeout','500ms',true),
          pg_catalog.set_config('idle_in_transaction_session_timeout','5s',true),
          pg_catalog.set_config('bytea_output','hex',true)
        """,
        [],
        deadline
      )
  end

  defp query!(sql, params, deadline) do
    result =
      Ecto.Adapters.SQL.query!(LifecycleRepo, sql, params,
        timeout: remaining!(deadline),
        deadline: deadline,
        queue: false,
        log: false,
        telemetry_event: nil
      )

    remaining!(deadline)
    result
  end

  defp effect!(:admit, _deadline), do: :admitted

  defp effect!({:bootstrap, d, metadata}, deadline) do
    c = d.context
    s = d.sealed

    snapshot!(
      query!(
        """
        SELECT public.mixer_browser_bootstrap($1::bytea,$2::bytea,$3::text,$4::bytea,
          $5::bytea,$6::text,$7::integer,$8::bigint,
          ROW($9::text,$10::bytea,$11::bytea,$12::bytea)::public.mixer_browser_cipher,
          $13::text) AS snapshot
        """,
        [
          c.browser_id,
          c.cookie_digest,
          c.generation,
          c.csrf_digest,
          c.config_digest,
          c.profile_id,
          c.profile_version,
          d.expires_at,
          s.key_id,
          s.iv,
          s.tag,
          s.ciphertext,
          metadata.request_id
        ],
        deadline
      )
    )
  end

  defp effect!({operation, input}, deadline) when operation in [:load, :discover_begin] do
    snapshot!(
      query!(
        """
        SELECT public.mixer_browser_load($1::bytea,$2::bytea) AS snapshot
        """,
        [input.cookie_digest, input.lease.runtime.configuration_digest],
        deadline
      )
    )
  end

  defp effect!({:begin, d, metadata}, deadline) do
    c = d.context
    a = d.attempt_context
    s = d.sealed
    v = d.attempt_sealed

    snapshot!(
      query!(
        """
        SELECT public.mixer_browser_begin($1::bytea,$2::bytea,$3::bytea,$4::bigint,
          ROW($5::bytea,$6::bytea,$7::text,$8::integer,$9::text,$10::text,$11::text,$12::bigint,
            ROW($13::text,$14::bytea,$15::bytea,$16::bytea)::public.mixer_browser_cipher)::public.mixer_browser_attempt,
          ROW($17::text,$18::bytea,$19::bytea,$20::bytea)::public.mixer_browser_cipher,$21::text) AS snapshot
        """,
        [
          c.cookie_digest,
          c.csrf_digest,
          c.config_digest,
          d.source.browser["revision"],
          a.state_digest,
          :crypto.hash(:sha256, d.nonce),
          a.profile_id,
          a.profile_version,
          a.issuer,
          a.client_id,
          a.redirect_uri,
          a.expires_at,
          v.key_id,
          v.iv,
          v.tag,
          v.ciphertext,
          s.key_id,
          s.iv,
          s.tag,
          s.ciphertext,
          metadata.request_id
        ],
        deadline
      )
    )
  end

  defp snapshot!(%Postgrex.Result{
         command: :select,
         columns: ["snapshot"],
         rows: [[raw]],
         num_rows: 1,
         messages: []
       }),
       do: raw

  defp decode!(:admit, :admitted), do: :admitted
  defp decode!({:load, _}, nil), do: nil
  defp decode!({:discover_begin, _}, nil), do: nil

  defp decode!({:bootstrap, d, _}, raw) do
    {:ok, %StoredSnapshot{} = s} = StoredSnapshot.decode(raw)
    b = s.browser
    true = s.attempt === nil and s.attempt_envelope === nil
    true = s.session_envelope.context === d.context and s.session_envelope.sealed === d.sealed
    true = b["status"] === "preauth" and b["epoch"] === 1 and b["revision"] === 1
    true = b["audit_sequence"] === 1 and b["initial_config_digest"] === d.context.config_digest
    true = b["created_at"] === b["last_seen_at"] and b["created_at"] >= d.lease.started_at
    true = b["absolute_expires_at"] === d.expires_at and b["idle_expires_at"] === d.expires_at
    s
  end

  defp decode!({:load, input}, raw) do
    {:ok, %StoredSnapshot{} = s} = StoredSnapshot.decode(raw)
    preauth_source!(s, input)
    # Ordinary preauth load remains deliberately narrower than begin discovery.
    true = s.attempt === nil and s.attempt_envelope === nil
    s
  end

  defp decode!({:discover_begin, input}, raw) do
    {:ok, %StoredSnapshot{} = s} = StoredSnapshot.decode(raw)
    preauth_source!(s, input)
    pending_source!(s, input.lease.runtime.browser_config)
    s
  end

  defp decode!({:begin, d, _}, raw) do
    {:ok, %StoredSnapshot{} = s} = StoredSnapshot.decode(raw)
    b = d.source.browser
    # Claim/provider rejection can change audit_sequence without revision. CAS
    # alone cannot admit that race: compare every produced browser field here.
    true =
      s.browser === %{
        b
        | "epoch" => b["epoch"] + 1,
          "revision" => b["revision"] + 1,
          "audit_sequence" => b["audit_sequence"] + 1
      }

    true = s.session_envelope.context === d.context and s.session_envelope.sealed === d.sealed

    true =
      s.attempt_envelope.context === d.attempt_context and
        s.attempt_envelope.sealed === d.attempt_sealed

    true =
      s.attempt["created_at"] >= d.lease.started_at and
        s.attempt["created_at"] <= System.system_time(:second)

    true =
      s.attempt ===
        attempt_fields(
          d.attempt_context,
          d.attempt_sealed,
          :crypto.hash(:sha256, d.nonce),
          s.attempt["created_at"]
        )

    true = System.system_time(:second) < d.attempt_context.expires_at
    s
  end

  defp preauth_source!(%StoredSnapshot{} = s, input) do
    b = s.browser
    config = input.lease.runtime.browser_config
    e = s.session_envelope
    true = map_size(s) == 5
    true = b["status"] === "preauth"
    true = b["cookie_digest"] === input.cookie_digest
    true = b["config_digest"] === input.lease.runtime.configuration_digest
    true = b["initial_config_digest"] === input.lease.runtime.configuration_digest
    true = b["expected_profile_id"] === config.profile_id
    true = b["expected_profile_version"] === config.profile_version

    true =
      e.context === %{
        purpose: :preauth,
        browser_id: b["id"],
        cookie_digest: b["cookie_digest"],
        csrf_digest: b["csrf_digest"],
        epoch: b["epoch"],
        revision: b["revision"],
        generation: b["generation"],
        vault_generation: e.context.vault_generation,
        config_digest: b["config_digest"],
        profile_id: config.profile_id,
        profile_version: config.profile_version,
        principal_id: nil,
        family_id: nil,
        credential_ref: nil,
        credential_revision: nil
      }

    true =
      Enum.all?(
        ~w(profile_id profile_version principal_id family_id credential_ref credential_revision),
        &is_nil(b[&1])
      )

    :ok
  end

  defp pending_source!(%StoredSnapshot{attempt: nil, attempt_envelope: nil}, _), do: :ok

  defp pending_source!(%StoredSnapshot{} = s, config) do
    a = s.attempt
    b = s.browser
    e = s.attempt_envelope

    c = %{
      purpose: :attempt,
      state_digest: a["state_digest"],
      browser_id: b["id"],
      cookie_digest: b["cookie_digest"],
      epoch: b["epoch"],
      revision: b["revision"],
      generation: b["generation"],
      config_digest: b["config_digest"],
      profile_id: config.profile_id,
      profile_version: config.profile_version,
      issuer: config.issuer,
      client_id: config.client_id,
      redirect_uri: config.redirect_uri,
      expires_at: a["expires_at"]
    }

    true = e.context === c
    true = raw?(a["state_digest"], 32) and raw?(a["nonce_digest"], 32)
    true = a["created_at"] >= b["created_at"] and a["created_at"] <= System.system_time(:second)
    true = a["expires_at"] > a["created_at"] and a["expires_at"] <= a["created_at"] + 300
    true = a["expires_at"] <= min(b["absolute_expires_at"], b["idle_expires_at"])
    true = a === attempt_fields(c, e.sealed, a["nonce_digest"], a["created_at"])
    :ok
  end

  defp attempt_fields(c, sealed, nonce_digest, created_at) do
    %{
      "state_digest" => c.state_digest,
      "browser_id" => c.browser_id,
      "browser_epoch" => c.epoch,
      "browser_revision" => c.revision,
      "cookie_digest" => c.cookie_digest,
      "generation" => c.generation,
      "config_digest" => c.config_digest,
      "profile_id" => c.profile_id,
      "profile_version" => c.profile_version,
      "issuer" => c.issuer,
      "client_id" => c.client_id,
      "redirect_uri" => c.redirect_uri,
      "return_route" => "workspace",
      "nonce_digest" => nonce_digest,
      "created_at" => created_at,
      "expires_at" => c.expires_at,
      "status" => "pending",
      "claim_digest" => nil,
      "claimed_at" => nil,
      "claim_expires_at" => nil,
      "completion_reason" => nil,
      "ciphertext_version" => 1,
      "key_id" => sealed.key_id,
      "iv" => bytea_hex(sealed.iv),
      "tag" => bytea_hex(sealed.tag),
      "ciphertext" => bytea_hex(sealed.ciphertext)
    }
  end

  defp begin_draft?(%PreauthDraft.Begin{} = d) do
    runtime = d.lease.runtime
    config = runtime.browser_config
    source = d.source
    input = %PreauthDraft.Load{lease: d.lease, cookie_digest: d.context.cookie_digest}
    :ok = preauth_source!(source, input)
    :ok = pending_source!(source, config)
    c = source.session_envelope.context

    expected_context = %{
      c
      | epoch: c.epoch + 1,
        revision: c.revision + 1,
        vault_generation: c.vault_generation + 1
    }

    expires =
      min(
        d.lease.started_at + 300,
        min(source.browser["idle_expires_at"], source.browser["absolute_expires_at"])
      )

    expected_attempt = %{
      purpose: :attempt,
      state_digest: :crypto.hash(:sha256, d.state),
      browser_id: c.browser_id,
      cookie_digest: c.cookie_digest,
      epoch: c.epoch + 1,
      revision: c.revision + 1,
      generation: c.generation,
      config_digest: runtime.configuration_digest,
      profile_id: config.profile_id,
      profile_version: config.profile_version,
      issuer: config.issuer,
      client_id: config.client_id,
      redirect_uri: config.redirect_uri,
      expires_at: expires
    }

    with true <-
           map_size(d) == 12 and d.context === expected_context and
             d.attempt_context === expected_attempt,
         true <- Enum.all?([d.state, d.nonce, d.verifier, d.csrf], &Protocol.token?/1),
         true <- length(Enum.uniq([d.state, d.nonce, d.verifier])) == 3,
         true <- System.system_time(:second) < expires,
         {:ok, url} <-
           Protocol.authorization_url(config, %{
             state: d.state,
             nonce: d.nonce,
             verifier: d.verifier
           }),
         true <- d.url === url and byte_size(url) <= 8192,
         {:ok, old} <- Vault.open(runtime.custody.key, c, source.session_envelope.sealed),
         true <- old === %Vault.Preauth{csrf: d.csrf},
         {:ok, new} <- Vault.open(runtime.custody.key, d.context, d.sealed),
         true <- new === old,
         {:ok, verifier} <- Vault.open(runtime.custody.key, d.attempt_context, d.attempt_sealed),
         true <- verifier === %Vault.Verifier{verifier: d.verifier},
         true <- authenticated_pending?(source, runtime.custody.key) do
      true
    else
      _ -> false
    end
  end

  defp authenticated_pending?(%StoredSnapshot{attempt: nil, attempt_envelope: nil}, _), do: true

  defp authenticated_pending?(%StoredSnapshot{attempt_envelope: e}, key),
    do: match?({:ok, %Vault.Verifier{}}, Vault.open(key, e.context, e.sealed))

  defp bootstrap_draft?(%PreauthDraft.Bootstrap{} = d) do
    c = d.context
    runtime = d.lease.runtime
    config = runtime.browser_config

    map_size(d) == 7 and is_integer(d.expires_at) and d.expires_at == d.lease.started_at + 300 and
      c.purpose === :preauth and c.epoch === 1 and c.revision === 1 and c.vault_generation === 1 and
      c.cookie_digest === :crypto.hash(:sha256, d.cookie) and
      c.csrf_digest === :crypto.hash(:sha256, d.csrf) and
      c.config_digest === runtime.configuration_digest and c.profile_id === config.profile_id and
      c.profile_version === config.profile_version and
      match?({:ok, _}, Vault.associated_data(d.sealed.key_id, c)) and
      match?({:ok, %Vault.Preauth{}}, Vault.open(runtime.custody.key, c, d.sealed))
  end

  defp checkpoint!(nil, deadline), do: remaining!(deadline)

  defp checkpoint!(lease, deadline) do
    true = lease.deadline === deadline
    :ok = RuntimeOwner.checkpoint(lease)
    remaining!(deadline)
  end

  defp remaining!(deadline) do
    remaining = deadline - System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    true = is_integer(deadline) and remaining > 0 and remaining <= 5_000
    remaining
  end

  defp metadata?(%{request_id: id} = metadata)
       when map_size(metadata) == 1 and is_binary(id) and byte_size(id) == 32,
       do: Enum.all?(:binary.bin_to_list(id), &(&1 in ?0..?9 or &1 in ?a..?f))

  defp metadata?(_), do: false
  defp raw?(value, size), do: is_binary(value) and byte_size(value) == size
  defp bytea_hex(value), do: "\\x" <> Base.encode16(value, case: :lower)
end

defmodule MixerHosted.BrowserAuth.RuntimeOwner do
  @moduledoc """
  Manually supervised, fixed preauthentication owner. No Application wiring yet.

  Storage readiness requires both current catalogs on the dedicated pool. It is
  never browser authentication readiness. Startup receives trusted configuration;
  this component cannot attest that a future Application used the same loader.
  Private preauthentication values must never be logged or serialized to HTTP.
  """
  use GenServer
  alias MixerHosted.BrowserAuth.{ConfigurationDigest, Custody, LifecycleRepo}

  alias MixerHosted.BrowserAuth.{
    PreauthDraft,
    Protocol,
    RuntimeConfig,
    Store,
    StoredSnapshot,
    Vault
  }

  alias MixerHosted.Identity.KeyOwner

  def start_link(%RuntimeConfig{} = runtime),
    do: GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, runtime, name: __MODULE__)

  def status do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :status, 1000)
  catch
    :exit, _ -> %{phase: :unavailable, generation: 0}
  end

  @doc "Creates private preauthentication data only; no authenticated session or HTTP cookie is installed."
  def bootstrap(metadata) do
    deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + 5000
    wall = System.system_time(:second)

    with true <- metadata?(metadata),
         {:ok, lease} <- reserve(deadline, wall) do
      execute(lease, fn ->
        cookie = Protocol.random_token()
        csrf = Protocol.random_token()
        runtime = lease.runtime
        config = runtime.browser_config

        context = %{
          purpose: :preauth,
          browser_id: :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16),
          cookie_digest: :crypto.hash(:sha256, cookie),
          csrf_digest: :crypto.hash(:sha256, csrf),
          epoch: 1,
          revision: 1,
          generation: Protocol.random_token(),
          vault_generation: 1,
          config_digest: runtime.configuration_digest,
          profile_id: config.profile_id,
          profile_version: config.profile_version,
          principal_id: nil,
          family_id: nil,
          credential_ref: nil,
          credential_revision: nil
        }

        with {:ok, sealed} <- Vault.seal(runtime.custody.key, context, %Vault.Preauth{csrf: csrf}) do
          draft = %PreauthDraft.Bootstrap{
            lease: lease,
            context: context,
            sealed: sealed,
            cookie: cookie,
            csrf: csrf,
            expires_at: wall + 300
          }

          finish_result(lease, cookie, Store.bootstrap(draft, metadata))
        else
          _ -> Store.failure(:effect, :not_started)
        end
      end)
    else
      _ -> Store.failure(:admission, :not_started)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> Store.failure(:admission, :not_started)
  catch
    _, _ -> Store.failure(:admission, :not_started)
  end

  def load(cookie) do
    deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + 5000
    wall = System.system_time(:second)

    with true <- Protocol.token?(cookie),
         {:ok, lease} <- reserve(deadline, wall) do
      execute(lease, fn ->
        input = %PreauthDraft.Load{lease: lease, cookie_digest: :crypto.hash(:sha256, cookie)}
        finish_result(lease, cookie, Store.load(input))
      end)
    else
      _ -> Store.failure(:admission, :not_started)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> Store.failure(:admission, :not_started)
  catch
    _, _ -> Store.failure(:admission, :not_started)
  end

  @doc "Begins only a private preauthentication OIDC attempt; no route or authenticated session is installed."
  def begin_login(cookie, raw_headers, return_route, metadata) do
    deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + 5000
    wall = System.system_time(:second)

    with true <- metadata?(metadata) and return_route === :workspace and Protocol.token?(cookie),
         {:ok, ^cookie} <- Protocol.parse_session_cookie(raw_headers),
         {:ok, lease} <- reserve(deadline, wall) do
      execute(lease, fn ->
        input = %PreauthDraft.Load{lease: lease, cookie_digest: :crypto.hash(:sha256, cookie)}

        with {:ok, %StoredSnapshot{} = source} <- Store.discover_begin(input),
             {:ok, draft} <- prepare_begin(lease, raw_headers, source),
             {:ok, _snapshot} <- Store.begin_login(draft, metadata) do
          finish_receipt(lease, draft.attempt_context.expires_at, %PreauthDraft.Authorization{
            url: draft.url,
            expires_at: draft.attempt_context.expires_at
          })
        else
          {:error, %Store.Failure{}} = error -> error
          _ -> Store.failure(:decode, :committed)
        end
      end)
    else
      _ -> Store.failure(:admission, :not_started)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> Store.failure(:admission, :not_started)
  catch
    _, _ -> Store.failure(:admission, :not_started)
  end

  defp prepare_begin(lease, raw_headers, source) do
    runtime = lease.runtime
    config = runtime.browser_config
    envelope = source.session_envelope

    expires =
      min(
        lease.started_at + 300,
        min(source.browser["idle_expires_at"], source.browser["absolute_expires_at"])
      )

    with :ok <- checkpoint(lease),
         :preauth <- envelope.context.purpose,
         {:ok, %Vault.Preauth{csrf: csrf}} <-
           Vault.open(runtime.custody.key, envelope.context, envelope.sealed),
         :ok <- Protocol.verify_csrf(config, raw_headers, csrf),
         true <- System.system_time(:second) < expires do
      state = Protocol.random_token()
      nonce = Protocol.random_token()
      verifier = Protocol.random_token()
      c = envelope.context

      context = %{
        c
        | epoch: c.epoch + 1,
          revision: c.revision + 1,
          vault_generation: c.vault_generation + 1
      }

      attempt = %{
        purpose: :attempt,
        state_digest: :crypto.hash(:sha256, state),
        browser_id: context.browser_id,
        cookie_digest: context.cookie_digest,
        epoch: context.epoch,
        revision: context.revision,
        generation: context.generation,
        config_digest: runtime.configuration_digest,
        profile_id: config.profile_id,
        profile_version: config.profile_version,
        issuer: config.issuer,
        client_id: config.client_id,
        redirect_uri: config.redirect_uri,
        expires_at: expires
      }

      with {:ok, url} <-
             Protocol.authorization_url(config, %{state: state, nonce: nonce, verifier: verifier}),
           true <- byte_size(url) <= 8192,
           {:ok, sealed} <- Vault.seal(runtime.custody.key, context, %Vault.Preauth{csrf: csrf}),
           {:ok, attempt_sealed} <-
             Vault.seal(runtime.custody.key, attempt, %Vault.Verifier{verifier: verifier}),
           :ok <- checkpoint(lease) do
        {:ok,
         %PreauthDraft.Begin{
           lease: lease,
           source: source,
           context: context,
           sealed: sealed,
           attempt_context: attempt,
           attempt_sealed: attempt_sealed,
           state: state,
           nonce: nonce,
           verifier: verifier,
           csrf: csrf,
           url: url
         }}
      else
        {:error, %Store.Failure{}} = error -> error
        _ -> Store.failure(:effect, :not_started)
      end
    else
      {:error, %Store.Failure{}} = error -> error
      _ -> Store.failure(:decode, :committed)
    end
  end

  # These are closed internal owner messages. Actual GenServer caller identity
  # and exact retained lease equality are checked; no supplied PID is authority.
  @doc false
  def checkpoint(%PreauthDraft.Lease{} = lease), do: call(lease, {:checkpoint, lease})
  def checkpoint(_), do: Store.failure(:admission, :not_started)

  defp reserve(deadline, wall),
    do: GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:reserve, deadline, wall}, remaining(deadline))

  defp execute(lease, operation) do
    # Only the fixed private orchestration functions create this closure;
    # no exported function accepts caller code or runs provider I/O.
    result =
      try do
        operation.()
      rescue
        _ -> Store.failure(:effect, :unknown)
      catch
        _, _ -> Store.failure(:commit, :unknown)
      end

    case result do
      %PreauthDraft.Publication{} = receipt ->
        # Finish already released the exact retained caller permit. No external
        # cleanup call may delay a successful value after this final sample.
        publish(lease, receipt)

      error ->
        if match?({:error, %Store.Failure{}}, error), do: call(lease, {:failed, lease, error})

        # Caller-authorized fallback only. Expiry/monitors clean up after the
        # unchanged deadline. A completed finish needs no second release.
        if System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) < lease.deadline,
          do: call(lease, {:release, lease})

        error
    end
  end

  defp finish_receipt(lease, expires, value) do
    case call(lease, {:finish, lease, expires}) do
      {:ok, checked_wall} when is_integer(checked_wall) ->
        %PreauthDraft.Publication{checked_wall: checked_wall, expires_at: expires, value: value}

      _ ->
        Store.failure(:commit, :committed)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> Store.failure(:commit, :committed)
  catch
    _, _ -> Store.failure(:commit, :committed)
  end

  defp publish(lease, receipt) do
    # The retained PID/status samples current dependency/configuration binding;
    # neither a registered replacement nor a new timeout can authorize release.
    with true <- System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) < lease.deadline,
         %{phase: :storage_ready, generation: generation} <- call(lease, :status),
         true <- generation === lease.generation,
         wall = System.system_time(:second),
         true <- wall >= receipt.checked_wall,
         true <- is_nil(receipt.expires_at) or wall < receipt.expires_at,
         true <- System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) < lease.deadline,
         true <- Process.whereis(__MODULE__) === lease.owner do
      {:ok, receipt.value}
    else
      _ -> Store.failure(:commit, :committed)
    end
  rescue
    _ -> Store.failure(:commit, :committed)
  catch
    _, _ -> Store.failure(:commit, :committed)
  end

  defp finish_result(lease, _cookie, {:ok, nil}) do
    finish_receipt(lease, nil, nil)
  end

  defp finish_result(lease, cookie, {:ok, snapshot}) do
    # Store has returned a confirmed COMMIT before any decryption occurs here.
    envelope = snapshot.session_envelope
    expires_at = min(snapshot.browser["idle_expires_at"], snapshot.browser["absolute_expires_at"])

    with :preauth <- envelope.context.purpose,
         {:ok, %Vault.Preauth{csrf: csrf}} <-
           Vault.open(lease.runtime.custody.key, envelope.context, envelope.sealed) do
      finish_receipt(lease, expires_at, %PreauthDraft.Preauth{
        cookie: cookie,
        csrf: csrf,
        expires_at: expires_at,
        source: snapshot
      })
    else
      _ -> Store.failure(:decode, :committed)
    end
  end

  defp finish_result(_lease, _cookie, error), do: error

  defp call(lease, message) do
    if Process.whereis(__MODULE__) === lease.owner,
      do: GenServer.call(lease.owner, message, remaining(lease.deadline)),
      else: Store.failure(:commit, :committed)
  catch
    :exit, _ -> Store.failure(:commit, :committed)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(%RuntimeConfig{mode: :disabled} = runtime) do
    if Enum.all?(
         [
           runtime.browser_config,
           runtime.configuration_digest,
           runtime.lifecycle_repo,
           runtime.expected_roles,
           runtime.custody
         ],
         &is_nil/1
       ),
       do: {:ok, %{phase: :disabled, generation: 0, operations: %{}, monitors: %{}}},
       else: {:stop, :session_unavailable}
  end

  def init(%RuntimeConfig{mode: :configured} = runtime) do
    deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + 5000

    with :ok <- validate_runtime(runtime),
         repo when is_pid(repo) <- Process.whereis(LifecycleRepo),
         identity when is_pid(identity) <- Process.whereis(KeyOwner),
         ordinary when is_pid(ordinary) <- Process.whereis(MixerHosted.Repo) do
      monitors = Map.new([repo, identity, ordinary], &{Process.monitor(&1), &1})

      phase =
        if Store.admit(runtime, deadline) === {:ok, :admitted},
          do: :storage_ready,
          else: :unavailable

      {:ok,
       %{
         phase: phase,
         generation: 1,
         runtime: runtime,
         repo: repo,
         identity: identity,
         ordinary: ordinary,
         operations: %{},
         monitors: monitors
       }}
    else
      _ -> {:stop, :session_unavailable}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def format_status(status) do
    Map.new(status, fn
      {:state, state} -> {:state, Map.take(state, [:phase, :generation])}
      {key, _} when key in [:message, :reason, :log] -> {key, :redacted}
      pair -> pair
    end)
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:status, _from, state) do
    state = current(state)
    {:reply, Map.take(state, [:phase, :generation]), state}
  end

  def handle_call({:reserve, deadline, wall}, {caller, _}, state) do
    state = current(state)

    if state.phase === :storage_ready and map_size(state.operations) < 32 and
         valid_time?(deadline, wall) do
      ref = make_ref()

      lease = %PreauthDraft.Lease{
        owner: self(),
        reference: ref,
        caller: caller,
        generation: state.generation,
        deadline: deadline,
        started_at: wall,
        runtime: state.runtime
      }

      monitor = Process.monitor(caller)
      expiry = make_ref()
      timer = Process.send_after(self(), {:expire, ref, expiry}, remaining(deadline))

      operations =
        Map.put(state.operations, ref, %{
          lease: lease,
          monitor: monitor,
          timer: timer,
          expiry: expiry,
          last_wall: wall
        })

      {:reply, {:ok, lease}, %{state | operations: operations}}
    else
      {:reply, Store.failure(:admission, :not_started), state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:checkpoint, lease}, {caller, _}, state) do
    state = current(state)
    {valid, state} = sample_lease(state, lease, caller)

    reply =
      if valid, do: :ok, else: Store.failure(:commit, :committed)

    {:reply, reply, state}
  end

  def handle_call({:finish, lease, expires}, {caller, _}, state) do
    state = current(state)
    {current_lease, state} = sample_lease(state, lease, caller)
    checked_wall = if current_lease, do: state.operations[lease.reference].last_wall

    valid =
      current_lease and
        (is_nil(expires) or (is_integer(expires) and checked_wall < expires))

    reply =
      if valid,
        do: {:ok, checked_wall},
        else: Store.failure(:commit, :committed)

    state = if valid, do: release(state, lease.reference), else: state
    {:reply, reply, state}
  end

  def handle_call({:failed, lease, {:error, %Store.Failure{} = error}}, {caller, _}, state) do
    if owned_lease?(state, lease, caller) and failure?(error) do
      state =
        if (error.phase === :admission and error.outcome !== :not_started) or
             error.outcome === :unknown, do: invalidate(state), else: state

      {:reply, :ok, release(state, lease.reference)}
    else
      {:reply, Store.failure(:admission, :not_started), state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:release, lease}, {caller, _}, state) do
    if owned_lease?(state, lease, caller),
      do: {:reply, :ok, release(state, lease.reference)},
      else: {:reply, Store.failure(:admission, :not_started), state}
  end

  def handle_call(_, _from, state), do: {:reply, Store.failure(:admission, :not_started), state}

  @impl true
  def handle_cast(_, state), do: {:noreply, state}

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:DOWN, monitor, :process, _pid, _reason}, state) do
    if Map.has_key?(state.monitors, monitor) do
      {:noreply, invalidate(state)}
    else
      reference =
        Enum.find_value(state.operations, fn {ref, operation} ->
          if operation.monitor === monitor, do: ref
        end)

      {:noreply, release(state, reference)}
    end
  end

  def handle_info({:expire, reference, expiry}, state) do
    # An expired operation may be waiting for COMMIT acknowledgement. Releasing
    # its slot cannot preserve readiness on an outcome we can no longer fence.
    state =
      case Map.get(state.operations, reference) do
        %{expiry: ^expiry} -> invalidate(state)
        _ -> state
      end

    {:noreply, state}
  end

  def handle_info(_, state), do: {:noreply, state}

  defp current(%{phase: :storage_ready} = state) do
    if Process.whereis(LifecycleRepo) === state.repo and
         Process.whereis(KeyOwner) === state.identity and
         Process.whereis(MixerHosted.Repo) === state.ordinary and repo_bound?(state.runtime),
       do: state,
       else: invalidate(state)
  end

  defp current(state), do: state

  defp invalidate(%{phase: :disabled} = state), do: state

  defp invalidate(state) do
    state = Enum.reduce(Map.keys(state.operations), state, &release(&2, &1))
    %{state | phase: :unavailable, generation: state.generation + 1}
  end

  defp owned_lease?(state, %PreauthDraft.Lease{} = lease, caller) do
    case Map.get(state.operations, lease.reference) do
      %{lease: ^lease} -> lease.caller === caller and lease.owner === self()
      _ -> false
    end
  end

  defp owned_lease?(_, _, _), do: false

  defp failure?(
         %Store.Failure{code: :session_unavailable, phase: phase, outcome: outcome} = error
       ),
       do:
         map_size(error) == 4 and phase in [:admission, :effect, :decode, :commit] and
           outcome in [:not_started, :rolled_back, :committed, :unknown]

  defp failure?(_), do: false

  defp valid_lease?(state, lease, caller),
    do:
      state.phase === :storage_ready and
        owned_lease?(state, lease, caller) and lease.generation === state.generation and
        valid_time?(lease.deadline, lease.started_at)

  defp sample_lease(state, lease, caller) do
    if valid_lease?(state, lease, caller) do
      operation = Map.fetch!(state.operations, lease.reference)
      wall = System.system_time(:second)

      if wall >= operation.last_wall do
        operations = Map.put(state.operations, lease.reference, %{operation | last_wall: wall})
        {true, %{state | operations: operations}}
      else
        {false, invalidate(state)}
      end
    else
      {false, state}
    end
  end

  defp release(state, reference) do
    case Map.pop(state.operations, reference) do
      {nil, _} ->
        state

      {%{monitor: monitor, timer: timer}, operations} ->
        Process.demonitor(monitor, [:flush])
        Process.cancel_timer(timer)
        %{state | operations: operations}
    end
  end

  defp validate_runtime(runtime) do
    with true <- map_size(runtime) == 7,
         {:ok, digest} <- ConfigurationDigest.digest(runtime.browser_config),
         true <- digest === runtime.configuration_digest,
         %Custody{reference: reference, key: key} <- runtime.custody,
         true <- reference === runtime.browser_config.session_vault_ref,
         {:ok, custody} <-
           Custody.new(reference, %{reference: reference, key_id: key.id, key_bytes: key.bytes}),
         true <- custody === runtime.custody,
         true <- repo_bound?(runtime),
         true <-
           MixerHosted.Repo.config()[:username] === runtime.expected_roles.ordinary_runtime_login do
      :ok
    else
      _ -> :error
    end
  rescue
    _ -> :error
  end

  defp repo_bound?(runtime) do
    runtime.lifecycle_repo[:pool_size] === 2 and runtime.lifecycle_repo[:pool_count] === 1 and
      runtime.lifecycle_repo[:queue] === false and runtime.lifecycle_repo[:timeout] === 5000 and
      runtime.lifecycle_repo[:connect_timeout] === 5000 and
      runtime.lifecycle_repo[:show_sensitive_data_on_connection_error] === false and
      runtime.lifecycle_repo[:username] === runtime.expected_roles.lifecycle_login and
      LifecycleRepo.bound?(runtime.lifecycle_repo)
  rescue
    _ -> false
  end

  defp valid_time?(deadline, wall),
    do:
      is_integer(deadline) and is_integer(wall) and
        System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) < deadline and
        deadline <= System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + 5000 and
        System.system_time(:second) >= wall

  defp remaining(deadline), do: max(1, min(5000, deadline - System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)))

  defp metadata?(%{request_id: id} = metadata)
       when map_size(metadata) == 1 and is_binary(id) and byte_size(id) == 32,
       do: Enum.all?(:binary.bin_to_list(id), &(&1 in ?0..?9 or &1 in ?a..?f))

  defp metadata?(_), do: false
end

limitations: No stopped callback review/harness rerun or delegation
Protected dirty Store/workflow/callback sources never executed
Independent callback acceptance, main integration, UnitB, provider, session lifecycle and startup remain pending
scope: W14 source-only production session integration selection; no product source edits
